{
  "insight": "The model shows perfect performance on Coordinate Geometry but struggles significantly with JEE Main Advanced 2024 25 Pattern (40% accuracy) and Class XI XII Students Droppers (20% accuracy). Errors are concentrated around specific conceptual misunderstandings: the procedural steps for computing a minimal cover of functional dependencies and the typical daily study‑time recommendations for repeaters. Targeted remediation on these patterns should quickly lift overall accuracy.",
  "feedback": [
    {
      "topic": "JEE Main Advanced 2024 25 Pattern",
      "accuracy": 40,
      "priority": "High",
      "diagnosis": "Consistently selects the wrong sequence of steps for deriving a minimal cover (selected B instead of A). The model confuses the order of decomposition, extraneous attribute removal, and redundancy elimination.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Review textbook definition of a minimal cover and the three canonical steps.",
        "Create a concise mnemonic (e.g., \"Decompose → Remove Extraneous → Eliminate Redundant\") and embed it in prompts.",
        "Practice with 5‑10 additional minimal‑cover problems, explicitly checking each step.",
        "Add a verification sub‑prompt that asks the model to list the steps before answering."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "Class XI XII Students Droppers",
      "accuracy": 20,
      "priority": "High",
      "diagnosis": "The model over‑selects the lowest study‑time range, indicating a lack of awareness of typical recommended hours (8‑12 hrs) for repeaters preparing for JEE.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Compile recent counseling guidelines and survey data on daily study hours for repeaters.",
        "Train the model on a short fact sheet: \"Most experts recommend 8–12 hours of focused study per day for class‑XII repeaters.\"",
        "Run a set of 5‑7 similar schedule‑question prompts to reinforce the correct range.",
        "Introduce a sanity‑check prompt that compares the chosen option against the compiled guideline before finalizing the answer."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "JEE Main Advanced 2024 25 Pattern",
      "accuracy": 40,
      "priority": "Medium",
      "diagnosis": "Mistake count (3 per sample) suggests the model is guessing rather than reasoning; it fails to validate each step against the definition of functional dependency closure.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Add an intermediate reasoning step: ask the model to explain why each listed step is necessary.",
        "Include a short example of a functional dependency set and walk through the minimal‑cover process.",
        "Evaluate the model on a mixed‑topic batch to ensure transfer of the new reasoning pattern."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "Class XI XII Students Droppers",
      "accuracy": 20,
      "priority": "Medium",
      "diagnosis": "High mistake count (8) indicates the model is not referencing any external data source and defaults to an unrealistic low‑time estimate.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Integrate a citation module that pulls the latest JEE preparation study‑time statistics.",
        "Create a prompt template that forces the model to cite the source before answering.",
        "Test with variations of the question (different wording, numeric ranges) to confirm consistent correct selection."
      ]
    },
    {
      "topic": "Coordinate Geometry",
      "accuracy": 100,
      "priority": "Low",
      "diagnosis": "Performance is flawless; no error patterns observed.",
      "next_steps": [
        "Maintain current knowledge base with periodic refreshers.",
        "Introduce occasional mixed‑topic quizzes to ensure the model retains this proficiency when multitasking."
      ]
    }
  ]
}
